svg.text: Under a rising letter penalty, Qwen3-4B’s breadcrumb
notes fall from 90% to 24% letters, and the follower still
answers better with the notes than without them
percent of note tokens with a letter
The explorer’s notes for the same rooms at each check, as decoded
Qwen3-4B with a LoRA adapter on seven crumb games. Each note is 4 real vocabulary tokens, trained as soft tokens with full
gradient and written as greedy tokens. A letter is any character in a Unicode letter category, in any script. Penalty weight: up 1.5
times after each check where the loss with notes cut minus the loss with notes is at least 0.8 of the step-150 value, halved
